A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] was fought between the forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc]]'s [[Greater Maldrood]] at [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8.5 ABY]]. After Teradoc encountered the forces of the New Republic and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at [[Battle of Junction|Junction]], he was forced on the defensive as Ackbar attacked his territory.
